versions.subject: Windows redcannary
versions.detection:
selection_cmd:
    ScriptBlockText|contains|all: 
        - Copy-Item
        - '-Destination'
selection_path:
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - '\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Login Data'
        - '\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Login Data For Account'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: ScriptBlockText="*Copy-Item*" ScriptBlockText="*-Destination*" ScriptBlockText IN ("*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\Default\\Login Data*", "*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\Default\\Login Data For Account*")

c.t: P:ScriptBlockText|IN|('L', (('S', '*\\\\Google\\\\Chrome\\\\User Data\\\\Default\\\\Login Data For Account*'), ('S', '*\\\\Google\\\\Chrome\\\\User Data\\\\Default\\\\Login Data*')))|CTX:POS
